[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Shop sustainably for products made from sustainable materials.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for choosing energy-efficient devices:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Look for devices with Energy Star ratings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose devices with low standby power consumption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Consider the size and type of the device, favoring smaller devices and those with solid-state drives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Shop around for the best deals on energy-efficient models.
